page.title: {brand} – a short break for maintenance
page.heading: We’ll be back in a few minutes
page.body: We’re doing some maintenance on the site. Please come back in a few minutes.
page.trip: Have a booking? The address and the host’s contact details are in your booking confirmation email.

api: The site is down for a short maintenance break. Please try again in a few minutes.

admin.title: Emergency tools
admin.lead: For emergencies only. Each action asks for a fresh code from your authenticator app and is written to the audit log.

mode.title: Maintenance mode
mode.on: Maintenance mode is on: visitors see the “We’ll be back in a few minutes” page.
mode.off: The site is open to everyone.
mode.env: Maintenance mode was switched on by the hosting setting MAINTENANCE_MODE. To switch it off, remove that setting at the hosting and redeploy.
mode.stays: Still working: admins with 2-step login, the health check, scheduled jobs and security.txt.
mode.confirmOnBody: Every public page will show the “We’ll be back in a few minutes” page right away. Only admins with 2-step login can get in.
mode.confirmOffBody: The site opens again for every visitor within a minute.

sessions.title: Sign everyone out
sessions.lead: Ends every account’s login on every device – guests, hosts and staff – except this browser. Everyone has to log in again.
sessions.confirmBody: Every user is signed out at once, staff included. You stay logged in on this browser only.
sessions.done: {count, plural, =0 {There were no other logins} one {1 login ended} other {{count} logins ended}}
